definitions.Q: Gamma_decay_bound / Gamma_free; d = Q / free_tau with the empirical free lifetime
definitions.d2_ratio: A = (n/m)(a_M/a_O)(Q_O/Q_M)(E2_O/E2_M); an evaluated update changes Q and the E2/amplitude response together; absolute free normalization cancels

historical_conversion.identity: c_cons = c_src + Q_src g_src - Q_cons g_cons, only when the source normalization is established; a tau primitive is preferred whenever available
historical_conversion.status: source normalizations carried as alternatives; none chosen from rounded capture rates

d2_response.accepted_width_definition: Gamma_acc,ij = sum over channels of the integral of R_ij dGamma_i; invisible channels have zero response

stanislaus1987_paper.note: the paper prints no Q formula and also cites another evaluation; equal published results do not establish equal conventions
